hoy.titular: Countdown at City Bell: Estudiantes start training for Palmeiras

foto.alt: Coaching staff give instructions to two players during a training session at City Bell.

hoy.resumen: The squad returned to training at City Bell on Monday, beginning 12 days of preparation for the Copa Libertadores final against Palmeiras on Saturday 28th at the Centenario. Correa is still working apart, while Carrillo and Castro did gym work to ease their loads.

siete.titulo: Correa a doubt for the final
siete.texto: He is nursing a grade 2 tear in the biceps of his right leg and kept working apart from the group as training resumed. Even if he is cleared, he will lack match rhythm: a starting place is far from certain.

The squad returned to training at City Bell on Monday after the post-Supercopa break. According to the schedule reported in the media, they will train there daily until the trip to Montevideo, with Sunday 22nd off.
Both did gym work in the first session to ease the muscle fatigue left by the final in Córdoba. There is no injury for now: the coaching staff are protecting them.
Fans bought all 121 coaches organised by the club: a record convoy heading to the Centenario.
They play three Brasileirão matches in seven days: Cruzeiro (18th), Flamengo (21st) and Chapecoense (24th), four days before the final. They are also chasing the title, three points behind Flamengo.
The Uruguayan full-back injured his right thigh on Friday 13th on international duty. Palmeiras have given no return date and the Brazilian press see him as a long shot for the final.

siete.titulo: Recopa could be played in La Plata
siete.texto: Winning the Supercopa puts the Pincha into January's Recopa de Campeones round-robin with Rosario Central and the Copa Argentina winners. The UNO is one possible venue, but AFA has yet to confirm it.

linea.texto: The Pincha could play January's Recopa de Campeones in La Plata; the venue is not yet confirmed.
Estudiantes trained again at City Bell after the title in Córdoba, with Palmeiras already in mind.
Operation Montevideo: the squad are back in training with the focus on the final.
With the Supercopa trophy and plenty of joy, this is how preparations for the Libertadores final began.
Palmeiras still have no return date for Piquerez: he hurt his thigh with Uruguay and is a doubt for the final.
In Brazil there are warnings about Palmeiras' workload: 270 minutes in seven days before the final.
Two key weeks begin: the countdown starts on Monday and Medina gets key players back for the final.
The basketball team closed the Pre Federal regular season with a 71-56 win over Riberas del Paraná; Racing de Olavarría await in the play-offs.
Correa steps up his recovery at City Bell to arrive in the best possible shape for the final on the 28th.
Sad news for the Pincha: Mary, a lifelong fan and leading figure of the Agrupación Juan Sebastián Verón, has died.
Palmeiras play three matches before the final, and the schedule favours the Pincha.
Women's volleyball: a 3-1 defeat to San Gregorio, but their place in the 2027 División de Honor is already secured.
Medina made history: he is the first foreign manager to win a title with Estudiantes.
The squad remains on leave and returns to training on Monday in City Bell, with Palmeiras in sight.
